headline: Bitcoin Drops Below $77,000 Following Massive Binance Hack
summary: Bitcoin declined as much as 3.1% to fall as low as $76,300 after a $6.3 billion exploit at cryptocurrency exchange Binance, which crypto experts attributed to a North Korean military unit.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and major security breaches or thefts can trigger significant market-wide sell-offs and regulatory scrutiny across the digital asset sector.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: A major security breach at a leading exchange negatively impacts crypto investor sentiment and token prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The massive security breach and theft of billions in digital assets directly undermined investor confidence, prompting a sharp sell-off in Bitcoin.
